texto:
Info about each character's physical attributes, battle patterns, and so forth are stored in Data.
Jocasta has come from the future to recruit characters to prevent the destruction of the world.

Biometrics is used to Recruit a new character, or upgrade them using Rank Up.

ISO-8 is a strange item that first appeared on Earth after some peculiar events.
There are no specific details about the origin of ISO-8 but after much research it was discovered that it enhanced any objects it was combined with.
When ISO-8 is equipped on a character, they receive increased stats.

Norn Stones are stones with magical properties.
They have the power to satisfy the desires of its user and was often used for Loki's conspiracies.
Use Norn Stones to Increase Character Masteries and make your characters more powerful.

Gear Up Kit developed by Tony Stark.
Tony Stark created a kit that could easily upgrade gear during missions.
Use Gear Up Kits to upgrade character gear.

This is a Component Pack used by Stark Industries.
It contains various tools and blueprints used by Tony Stark.
Use the Component Pack to upgrade components in the S.H.I.E.L.D Lab.

Blueprints contain top secret designs created by Stark Industries.
Use Stark-branded Blueprints to upgrade components in the S.H.I.E.L.D. Lab.

Comic Cards are curious cards found in the possession of those from other dimensions.
Interestingly, there are pictures of various characters on the cards along with incomprehensible writings.
When Comic Cards are equipped, the bonus stats associated with each card will be added to all characters.

Artifacts can amplify characters' instinct.
Some artifacts grant passive skills to specific characters when equipped.
Enhance artifacts to amplify instinct, or dismantle to acquire enhance materials.

Artifacts' powers are condensed into Celestial Essence.
Dismantle artifacts to acquire Celestial Essence, and use it to enhance artifacts.

Swords are equipment which contain the power of legendary heroes.
Equipping a Sword applies its effect on all characters.

There are 7 different types of swords: the Sword of the Unknown and 6 Special Swords.
The Sword of the Unknown possesses a mysterious power and can be enchanted with various magical effects.

Enchantment Runes are stones containing the magical power of the Otherworld.
Enchantment Runes are used as Sword enchantment materials, and there are special Enchantment Runes which increase the chances of applying a specific element.

Custom Gears are pieces of equipment purpose-built to amplify or defend against a certain power.
When equipped to a character, they can increase stats or grant them a special skill.

There are two types of Custom Gears: Obelisks and C.T.P.s.
Obelisks are Custom Gears with moderate capabilities and are split into six grades from Normal to Mythic.
[cortado]

Norn Stones of Chaos are unique Norn Stones discovered in space.
The power of the Norn Stones was distorted by Thanos's cosmic power, transforming them into Norn Stones of Chaos.
Norn Stones of Chaos are used as materials to advance a fully leveled Tier-1 character to Tier-2, or to rank up characters recruited at Tier-2.

Black Anti-Matter is a unique substance created through Thanos's research.
By further developing anti-matter, Thanos produced Black Anti-Matter, which contains even greater energy.
Black Anti-Matter is used as a material to advance a fully leveled Tier-1 character to Tier-2, or to rank up characters recruited at Tier-2.

Uru enchanted by the magical power of Odin.
Enchanted Uru can be equipped when character’s gear reaches a set level.
Use Enchanted Uru on a character’s Gear to get bonus stats.

The M'kraan Crystal is a massive pink crystal so ancient that its origin is unknown.
It's said that if the M'kraan Crystal were to shatter, an immense gravitational energy would burst throughout the universe, pulling everything into a black hole and causing the collapse of the universe.
Even the fragments that broke off when the M'kraan Crystal was destroyed long ago still contain tremendous power.
Use M'kraan Shards to awaken Mutant characters.

The M'kraan Crystal is a massive pink crystal so ancient that its origin is unknown.
It's said that if the M'kraan Crystal were to shatter, an immense gravitational energy would burst throughout the universe, pulling everything into a black hole and causing the collapse of the universe.
The power contained within the M'kraan Crystal can restore the lost abilities of Mutants.
Use the M'kraan Crystal and Phoenix Feathers to advance Mutant characters to Tier-2.

The Phoenix is a cosmic entity said to bring about the destruction of all things.
Through the power of the Phoenix, Mutants gain tremendous power and abilities.
Although Phoenix Feathers contain very little of the Phoenix's power, even that is enough to grant immense amount of cosmic energy.
Use M'kraan Crystal and Phoenix Feathers to advance Mutant characters to Tier-2.

This gene leads (via transcription and translation) to an exotic protein.
This protein produces chemical signals inducing mutations on other genes, ending up with mutant organisms, variously empowered.
X-Gene is used to Recruit a new Mutant Character, or upgrade them using Rank Up.

Cosmic Cube is a cosmic artifact that possesses mysterious power capable of granting immense power to its user.
After a major incident that nearly altered the fate of the universe, the cube was destroyed and its fragments were scattered across the world. Even the shattered fragments are said to still contain tremendous power.
Cosmic Cube Fragments are materials used to enhance characters and can be used for Potential [cortado]

Essence of Dimension is a mysterious concentration of power emitted from dimensional rifts.
Research on this unknown substance, which contains the mixed energies of various dimensions, is still in its early stages.
Essence of Dimension is used as a material for Gear Upgrade beyond Lv. 20 and Tier-3 Advancement

Titan Component Pack is a tool that incorporates the advanced technology of the Titan race.
These devices, discovered aboard Thanos's ship, were improved through joint research Iron Man and Blue Marvel into technologies capable of enhancing characters.
Titan Component Packs are used as materials for Gear Upgrade beyond Lv. 20 and Tier-3 Advancement.

The Titan’s Record is an important document that contains records of Thanos’s various research.
Thanos conducted numerous experiments to enhance his own body, and has recorded the information.
Titan’s Record is used as material for Tier-3 Advancement.

Type Enhancement Kit is created by processing Carbonite, which is a substance that amplifies energy.
Tony Stark created this kit with Howard Stark from another dimension so characters with different types can benefit from the power of Carbonite.
Type Enhancement Kit can be used to enhance character type.

Awakening Crystal is a red crystal formed from powerful energy.
This crystal possesses a special power, but how it was created and what kind of power it truly holds remain largely unknown. When its power is activated, red energy bursts forth, awakening the character's Potential and granting new power.
Use the Awakening Crystal to awaken the Potential of certain characters.

The Mandalay Gem is composed of one of the most powerful minerals in the universe.
While many have fought to claim the Mandalay Gem, it was shattered in a clash with a powerful energy source and its fragments scattered all over the universe. The Mandalay Gem Fragments still emit powerful energy and grants its user special powers.
Use the Mandalay Gem Fragments to awaken the Potential of certain characters.

Story Fragments are the crystalized essence of mysterious dimensional powers.
These fragment contain the stories of the heroes that fight to protect the world.
Collect all Story Fragments to Craft Chests to obtain special rewards.

C.T.P. Reforging Core is a component that strengthens special gear, C.T.P.
The C.T.P. Reforging Core is made of Vibranium and amplifies the hidden powers within C.T.P. and makes it emanate greater power.
The C.T.P. Reforging Core is used as material to reforge C.T.P.

Card Crafting Cube is a metal component that unleashes the card's special power.
The Comic Card's new powers have been discovered after many experiments and studies, and its immense powers were unleashed through the Card Crafting Cube.
Card Crafting Cubes can be used as material to craft Comic Cards.

Dimension Rift Summon Stones are used to open the gate that teleports you to another spacetime.
Summon Stones can be acquired in Story, and are used for opening Dimension Rifts.

The Book of the Vishantiis a spellbook written by the Vishanti, the group of all-powerful mystic beings who govern magic.
It contains powerful white magic spells and defensive spells that can counter the evils of the Darkhold and other black magic.
The Book of the Vishanti can be used as Tier-4 Advancement material.

The Life Seed is one of the mysterious artifacts created by the Celestials.
Planted on a dead planet to give birth to new life, it has the power to kickstart creation and evolution.
The Life Seed enhances a hero and can be used for 2nd Potential Enhancement, Tier-4 Advancement, or as level up material for skills Lv. 7 or higher.

Carbonadium is a substance created in an attempt to replicate Adamantium.
It's stronger than steel and remarkably flexible.
Carbonadium is used as a material for Gear Upgrade beyond Lv. 26 and for Tier-4 Advancement.

Soul of the Faltine is a substance from the Dark Dimension, where the Faltine, beings born from pure magic, exist.
It carries the flame of the Faltine and possesses immense magical power.
Soul of the Faltine is used as a material for Gear Upgrade beyond Lv. 26 and for Tier-4 Advancement.

Eternal Flame is a flame that makes Odin's Blessing even more powerful.
Eternal Flame is used as material during Uru Awakening.
Power of Demiurge is a powerful material used to level up a Tier-4 character's Elite Gear.
Godstone is a material required to unlock and level limit break a Tier-4 character's Elite Gear.
Emblem Data is divided into the rarities Normal/Luxury/Rare/Heroic/Legendary/Mythic, and is used to level up emblems of the same rarity.
Emblem Enhancement Kits are a level-up material required at specific level ranges when leveling up emblems.

J.A.R.V.I.S. Data is obtained when you acquire a duplicate J.A.R.V.I.S. Chip. The duplicate Chip is automatically converted into exclusive Data.
Data is used to enhance Chips and to change options.

J.A.R.V.I.S. Data Shards can be obtained by dismantling J.A.R.V.I.S. Data.
Data Shards are used to enhance J.A.R.V.I.S. Chips.
